title: EvoCAD: Evolutionary CAD Code Generation with Vision Language Models
venue: IEEE 37th International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI)

publication.venue: IEEE 37th International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI)

mechanism.populationDetail: One population of six CAD codes is evolved for four generations without islands or genealogy structure.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The best-fitness object is copied unchanged into the next generation; no separate archive data structure is shown.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Generational update includes one unchanged elite; Algorithm 1 leaves other survivor-allocation details inside update().
mechanism.generationDetail: Independent code initialization precedes two-parent CAD-code fusion; selected crossover offspring receive unary refinement.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Compile errors trigger one self-debugging attempt; geometric and topology metrics require unavailable ground truth and are used for reporting, not search fitness.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Crossover selects two code parents by exponentiated average rank; optional mutation edits their one offspring.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/EvoCAD Evolutionary CAD Code Generation with Vision Language Models.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Survey currently cites EvoCAD under Single-Model Setting, but each run also invokes o3-mini as ranking RLM alongside GPT-4V or GPT-4o. Full prompt templates and detailed update() survivor rule are not exposed. Fixed exploration/exploitation is simultaneous variation and selection, not a discrete mode controller.
